svg.title: Geospatial indexing
svg.desc: A map of drivers with one rider. Without an index the rider is measured against every driver. With a geohash grid, only the rider's cell and its 8 neighbors are searched, a handful of candidates get an exact distance, and the closest driver turns out to be just across a cell border.
svg.text: Check only the rider's cell and its 8 neighbors, not every driver.
